title: Privacy: a cloud erase whose session changed during the engine call, or that came back with no view, never reaches showErased: the store does not count it, and it keeps the record it held before the erase
evidence: US-25 AC16g: CloudSync.erase hands every erase the engine finished to RecordStore.showErased, whatever the connection did during the await; eraseEnded already ignores a session no longer shown. showErased reads stillShown (CloudSync still shows the session) in its step: then it draws as before; otherwise drawErased (RecordStore+Source.swift) lands it only on that session's record, keeps a record read since (a newer session's or the phone's) as a stale erase's newer record is, and counts it either way. No view: counted, the record held marked as predating it (AC21). Tests: CloudConnectionPinsTests testAnEraseWhoseSessionClosedMeanwhileStillReachesTheStore_US25_AC16g (a Disconnect during the erase; not counted on main), EraseHeldUndrawnTests three AC16g. Was: ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/CloudSync.swift:198 (main 55d6fde5). From the adversary reviews of PR 1599 (F6, re-check F3)
